notes: Status requirements are campaign mechanics, not Naruto canon census claims. International recognition is a separate diplomatic agreement rather than an automatic consequence of self-declaration.

civil_economy.rule: Monthly settlement derives aggregate civilian activity from conserved residents. Local market capacity feeds later services; shortages and infrastructure pressure change integration/resistance; sufficiently attractive, supplied settlements can receive conserved neutral-proportional migrants from their persisted lawful source pool, while severe food insecurity can drive conserved return migration. When a material food, housing, or service development need persists, the administration can spend existing treasury currency into the containing private economy to build aggregate civilian resilience; this changes later food support, infrastructure capacity, or service investment but never grants exact military/medical/workshop facilities. Production and consumption remain value-flow metrics, not minted currency. Jurisdiction tax is paid only by transferring existing currency from the containing regional private-economy holder to the exact treasury.
